decisions.reason: As a close-to-core software product that survived the first portfolio pruning and fits the firm's data-driven infrastructure strategy, it likely meets or is near aspiration levels, so with industry growth and some organisational slack management would keep it.

Although newer and therefore more uncertain, this flow measurement automation software is strongly aligned with the firm's established automation business and future direction, so boundedly rational management would likely continue it unless early results clearly fell short of aspirations.
